## Notes

- v4 & v5 in archive: old model with cut_auroc (v4 for population and v5 for multilevel)

- v2 for glmer only (never did 5-fold cv for bayesian models)

## Set Up


```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| code-fold: true

library(tidyverse)
library(tidymodels)

library(broom, include.only = "tidy")
library(janitor, include.only = c("tabyl"))
library(Matrix, exclude = c("expand", "pack", "unpack"))
library(corrr)
library(brms, exclude = c("populate", "mixture", "ar"))

options(conflicts.policy = "depends.ok")

source("https://github.com/jjcurtin/lab_support/blob/main/format_path.R?raw=true")
source("https://github.com/jjcurtin/lab_support/blob/main/fun_ml.R?raw=true")
source("https://github.com/jjcurtin/lab_support/blob/main/fun_eda.R?raw=true")
source("https://github.com/jjcurtin/lab_support/blob/main/chtc/static_files/fun_chtc.R?raw=true")

path_input <- format_path("optimize/modeling/chtc")
path_models <- format_path("optimize/modeling/models")
path_features <-  format_path("optimize/data_processed/features")
path_multilevel <- format_path("risk/data_processed/multilevel")

# set ggplot theme to minimal
theme_set(theme_minimal())

```

## Data

```{r}
configs_all <-
  read_csv(here::here(path_models,
                      str_c("auroc_", params$version, ".csv")),
           show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  mutate(algorithm = params$algorithm)

d <- read_csv(here::here(path_input,
                         str_c("train_", params$version, "/input/data_trn.csv")))
ids <- read_csv(here::here(path_multilevel, "features_ids.csv")) |> 
  glimpse()
```

```{r}
set.seed(03050321)
splits_kfold <- d |>
  vfold_cv(v = 5, repeats = 1, strata = "lapse")

feat_test <- map(1:5, \(i) assessment(splits_kfold$splits[[i]]) |> mutate(fold = i)) |> 
  list_rbind()
```

```{r}
model_lst_population <- read_rds(here::here(format_path("risk/models/multilevel"),
                                             "model_population_v2.rds"))
model_lst_multilevel <- read_rds(here::here(format_path("risk/models/multilevel"),
                                             "model_multilevel_v2.rds"))
feat_test <- map(1:5, \(i) assessment(splits_kfold$splits[[i]]) |> mutate(fold = i)) |> 
  list_rbind()
```

```{r}
pred_prob_tbl_population <- read_csv(here::here(format_path("risk/models/multilevel"),
                                "prob_out_population_v2.csv"))
pred_prob_tbl_multilevel <- read_csv(here::here(format_path("risk/models/multilevel"),
                                      "prob_out_multilevel_v2.csv"))
pred_prob_tbl_multilevel_fixed <- read_csv(here::here(format_path("risk/models/multilevel"),
                       "prob_out_fixed_multilevel_v2.csv"))
probs <- tibble(
  multilevel = 1 - pred_prob_tbl_multilevel$prob,
  multilevel_fixed = 1 - pred_prob_tbl_multilevel_fixed$prob,
  population = 1 - pred_prob_tbl_population$prob
)
```


## Fairness Analysis


```{r}
d_fairness <- feat_test |> 
  select(fold, subid, dttm_label, lapse) |> 
  cbind(probs) |> 
  left_join(ids |> select(subid, starts_with("demo")), by = "subid") |> 
  glimpse()
```

**Sex**

```{r}
d_fairness_male <- d_fairness |> 
  filter(demo_sex == "Male") |> 
  select(fold, subid, dttm_label, lapse, multilevel, population, multilevel_fixed)

d_fairness_female <- d_fairness |> 
  filter(demo_sex == "Female") |> 
  select(fold, subid, dttm_label, lapse, multilevel, population, multilevel_fixed)

# check if all folds have lapses
d_fairness_male |> 
  group_by(fold) |> 
  summarize(n = sum(lapse == "lapse"))
d_fairness_female |> 
  group_by(fold) |> 
  summarize(n = sum(lapse == "lapse"))

# Comparison
fairness_sex <- full_join(
  d_fairness_male |> 
    group_by(fold) |> 
    summarize(
      male_multilevel = roc_auc_vec(truth = factor(lapse), estimate = multilevel),
      male_multilevel_fixed = roc_auc_vec(truth = factor(lapse), estimate = multilevel_fixed),
      male_population = roc_auc_vec(truth = factor(lapse), estimate = population)
    ),
  d_fairness_female |> 
    group_by(fold) |> 
    summarize(
      female_multilevel = roc_auc_vec(truth = factor(lapse), estimate = multilevel),
      female_multilevel_fixed = roc_auc_vec(truth = factor(lapse), estimate = multilevel_fixed),
      female_population = roc_auc_vec(truth = factor(lapse), estimate = population)
    )
) |> 
  mutate(diff_multilevel = male_multilevel - female_multilevel,
         diff_multilevel_fixed = male_multilevel_fixed - female_multilevel_fixed,
         diff_population = male_population - female_population) |> 
  relocate(fold, diff_multilevel, diff_multilevel_fixed, diff_population) 

fairness_sex

fairness_sex |> skimr::skim_without_charts()
```

**Race**

```{r}
d_fairness_white <- d_fairness |> 
  filter(demo_race == "White/Caucasian") |> 
  select(fold, subid, dttm_label, lapse, multilevel, population, multilevel_fixed)

d_fairness_nonwhite <- d_fairness |> 
  filter(demo_race != "White/Caucasian") |> 
  select(fold, subid, dttm_label, lapse, multilevel, population, multilevel_fixed)

# check if all folds have lapses
d_fairness_white |> 
  group_by(fold) |> 
  summarize(n = sum(lapse == "lapse"))
d_fairness_nonwhite |> 
  group_by(fold) |> 
  summarize(n = sum(lapse == "lapse"))

# Comparison
fairness_race <- full_join(
  d_fairness_white |> 
    group_by(fold) |> 
    summarize(
      white_multilevel = roc_auc_vec(truth = factor(lapse), estimate = multilevel),
      white_multilevel_fixed = roc_auc_vec(truth = factor(lapse), estimate = multilevel_fixed),
      white_population = roc_auc_vec(truth = factor(lapse), estimate = population)
    ),
  d_fairness_nonwhite |> 
    group_by(fold) |> 
    summarize(
      nonwhite_multilevel = roc_auc_vec(truth = factor(lapse), estimate = multilevel),
      nonwhite_multilevel_fixed = roc_auc_vec(truth = factor(lapse), estimate = multilevel_fixed),
      nonwhite_population = roc_auc_vec(truth = factor(lapse), estimate = population)
    )
) |> 
  mutate(diff_multilevel = white_multilevel - nonwhite_multilevel,
         diff_multilevel_fixed = white_multilevel_fixed - nonwhite_multilevel_fixed,
         diff_population = white_population - nonwhite_population) |> 
  relocate(fold, diff_multilevel, diff_multilevel_fixed, diff_population)

fairness_race

fairness_race |> skimr::skim()
```
